gaps.description: 112 repositories are inventoried; 20 README reviews and 19 limited source reviews are pinned in the evidence ledger. The remaining 93 repositories still require source-level review, and the 19 reviewed scopes are not full repository certification.
gaps.next_action: Audit the remaining 93 repositories in batches; expand each limited review to dependencies, tests, workflows and runtime contracts.

gaps.description: 109 DEPENDS_ON edges were copied from the 92-record umbrella registry and remain candidate claims, not verified source dependencies.
gaps.next_action: Verify imports, API calls, package manifests, workflow references and runtime contracts.

gaps.description: No cross-repository API/event contracts have been independently extracted in this pass.
gaps.next_action: Create contracts directory with OpenAPI, JSON Schema and event envelope artifacts.

gaps.description: 39 proposed shared cores and domain routers may overlap existing repositories.
gaps.next_action: Perform capability overlap matrix before creating any repository.

gaps.description: Registry dependency assertions cite the umbrella registry blob rather than original source lines.
gaps.next_action: Replace or supplement each candidate edge with source-level evidence.

gaps.description: Playwright request guard applies policy only to top-level document navigations; subresource requests are continued without equivalent host/IP restrictions. Potential private-network/SSRF path through an allowlisted page.
gaps.next_action: Enforce policy for every request, resolve and reject private/loopback/link-local/reserved IPs, validate redirects and add local fixtures proving blocked subresource requests.

gaps.description: README describes local HTTP/SQLite restarts, but inspected article11 source is an in-memory state simulator with no real side effects.
gaps.next_action: Add reproducible HTTP/SQLite recovery experiments or narrow README claims to the implemented simulator.

gaps.description: README references local CPU measurements, but inspected source exposes an assumption-based cost calculator and no independent GPU benchmark harness.
gaps.next_action: Add reproducible CPU/GPU measurement scripts and provider invoice evidence, or narrow README claims.

gaps.description: Existing governance snapshots report 92 repositories in README and 75 in repository_federation_v2.yaml (2026-09-28), while the reconciled current inventory contains 112.
gaps.next_action: Synchronize the governance inventory from immutable GitHub IDs while preserving historical snapshot provenance.

gaps.description: Connector execution endpoint has no authentication and is disabled by default; enabling the environment flag is documented as private-development-only.
gaps.next_action: Keep connector execution disabled on public interfaces until tenant authentication, scoped authorization, audit, egress allowlist, quotas and secret management are implemented and tested.

gaps.description: synergy_system README snapshot dated 2026-11-20 says the cognitive-memory main branch is README-only, but current main contains a full Python package, tests, git dependency intelligence, cross-repository registry and contract intelligence.
gaps.next_action: Refresh governance snapshot from exact current main SHA; do not rely on stale README-only status.

gaps.description: The compatibility orchestrator applies POSIX RLIMITs and a minimal environment but does not enforce namespaces, seccomp, filesystem or network isolation. It is not a complete sandbox.
gaps.next_action: Keep untrusted service execution disabled or externally sandboxed until a dedicated isolation layer and adversarial tests are implemented.

gaps.description: Fair-value graph does not apply capacity/latency constraints; fee/slippage values are not bounded in Edge, and negative executable paths are silently filtered.
gaps.next_action: Add fee/slippage validation, capacity/latency-aware path evaluation and tests before using outputs for execution decisions.

gaps.description: Main-branch accounting recognition helper accepts settlement_payload=None, bypassing its reconciled-settlement precondition; an empty double-entry list also balances and is accepted.
gaps.next_action: Require reconciled settlement evidence for every recognition path (or explicit non-recognition classification), reject empty/zero journals and add bypass tests.

gaps.description: Inspected settlement engine keeps settlement records and idempotency keys in process memory; this does not survive restart and does not prove exactly-once external side effects.
gaps.next_action: Persist settlement state, idempotency keys and outbox atomically; add crash-after-provider-call recovery and reconciliation tests.

gaps.description: VaR/CVaR return 0 when fewer than five returns are available, so the risk core can understate uncertainty and continue to approve orders without sufficient history.
gaps.next_action: Make insufficient history an explicit blocker or use a conservative fallback; validate positive notional and side at the core boundary.

gaps.description: The repository named search_engline is a HardNAV multiplier simulation, not a general search engine; it cannot be treated as the search backend for classifieds, banks or real estate.
gaps.next_action: Map each actual search implementation to its domain and rename/clarify the repository role in the federation registry.

gaps.description: Lead OS schema has no tenant_id isolation and the API uses a single operator bearer token; it is not a safe multi-tenant CRM lead service as-is.
gaps.next_action: Add tenant-scoped document/review/outbox ownership, per-tenant auth and authorization, retention/deletion workflows and cross-tenant negative tests before multi-client hosting.

gaps.description: Current Maps implementation is a global globe plus EAEU boundary subset; higher-detail layers and live logistics/real-estate data integration are not established.
gaps.next_action: Define versioned geospatial contracts and source licensing/authority before routing commercial services through Maps.

gaps.description: Main branch package scripts reference missing tests/v3 and scripts/copy-www.js; inspected main tree has no messenger source or test suite despite README describing alpha.9.
gaps.next_action: Reconcile default branch with the claimed release artifact; add required source/test files or narrow main README/package scripts.

gaps.description: Workspace implementation exists on release/v1.0-desktop-rc but main is README-only; the release branch is not a production desktop installer and has no tenant-isolated public backend.
gaps.next_action: Keep branch status explicit; complete release build, GUI E2E, tenant/privacy review and provider adapter verification before production claims.

gaps.description: Main branch is a stub with no DAG planner or autonomous runtime; do not treat the architecture node as an orchestrator implementation.
gaps.next_action: Assign orchestration runtime ownership to verified components and keep Autopilot as a proposal until source is added.

gaps.description: AI Coder main implements requirement/change evidence contracts only, not a full autonomous coding agent.
gaps.next_action: Keep coding execution in a separate sandboxed component and reuse the evidence contract for approvals.

gaps.description: Repository describes settlement-aware graph arbitrage architecture but main branch contains only README and assets, no executable graph engine or tests.
gaps.next_action: Keep it as a specification; implement inside an existing graph owner or add code/tests before claiming an engine.

gaps.description: Pair OLS/z-score signals are non-authorizing and do not establish cointegration, stationarity, hedge stability or executable edge after costs.
gaps.next_action: Require aligned train/OOS data, cointegration/stationarity tests, rolling stability, borrow/funding, liquidity and cost-aware negative tests.

gaps.description: Main branch contains a PWA/Android source surface and UI descriptions of wallet/AGI/DAO/L1/MetaPay/mesh, but the source contract explicitly does not prove backend integrations or a built APK.
gaps.next_action: Bind each UI module to a versioned backend contract and attach successful APK build artifact evidence before claiming operational features.

gaps.description: Mobile source integrity contract verifies source files but explicitly returns artifact_built=false and store_published=false; source checks are not release evidence.
gaps.next_action: Add reproducible signed build workflow, artifact digest/attestation and install smoke tests before release claims.

gaps.description: Read-model helpers label payloads read-only but do not authenticate upstream evidence or verify canonical accounting/trust signatures.
gaps.next_action: Require validated contract envelope and source provenance before constructing any user-visible authoritative projection.

gaps.description: Tracked root artifact base-mainnet-deployer.key exists. Contents were deliberately not inspected; repository's own SECURITY_FEDERATION_BLOCKER confirms credential hygiene is an explicit federation blocker.
gaps.next_action: Immediately rotate/revoke the associated deployer credential, remove the file and sensitive history, move secrets to a secret manager, enable secret scanning/push protection and provide verified cleanup evidence. Keep deployment disabled.

gaps.description: Tracked .env, owner.env, bot1.env and bot2.env files are present in the repository tree. Contents were deliberately not inspected; README warns tracked configs may include secrets; root .gitignore was not found.
gaps.next_action: Treat any credentials as exposed until proven otherwise; rotate/revoke wallet and bot credentials, remove secret files/history, add secret scanning and provide evidence before any deployment.

gaps.description: Commitment replay guard stores consumed IDs in process memory and trusts supplied FINALIZED/digest fields; restart loses replay state and no chain proof/signature is verified.
gaps.next_action: Persist replay state transactionally with unique constraints and verify signed source authority/finality proofs plus reorg handling.

gaps.description: Repository incident report confirms an unencrypted SSH private key was committed to main history. Current tree removal is not proof that the credential was rotated/revoked or that history was sanitized.
gaps.next_action: Verify new key issuance, revoke old public key on every authorized host, inspect access logs, rotate dependent credentials and complete human-approved history sanitization.

gaps.description: turbo_scheduler_enqueue does not reject an already-enqueued task ID; duplicate enqueue can set next[id]=id and create a self-loop.
gaps.next_action: Track queued membership or add a state bitset, reject duplicates, and add regression tests for duplicate enqueue, dequeue/re-enqueue and queue count invariants.

gaps.description: Long-Term Harness main branch is README-only; no executable soak test framework exists in the inspected repository.
gaps.next_action: Keep long-term test coverage assigned to existing CI/soak workflows until this repository gains a reproducible runner.

gaps.description: MMConfig has no explicit validation for gamma, kappa, horizon, max_inventory or min spread; malformed values can produce invalid quote geometry or math errors.
gaps.next_action: Add immutable config validation for finite values and safe parameter ranges, plus property tests for non-crossed quotes and monotonic inventory/volatility behavior.

gaps.description: Validation contract permits an optional dataset manifest digest and does not verify the digest format or fetch/verify the dataset; strong validation runs can be emitted without bound dataset provenance.
gaps.next_action: Require a versioned dataset manifest and verify SHA-256/source revision before issuing a promotion gate.

gaps.description: DecisionPipeline risk-veto path references undefined exc and bare-raises outside an active exception; a risk veto can crash instead of returning a blocked decision.
gaps.next_action: Remove invalid exception path, return an explicit non-tradable veto decision, and add a test proving no execution adapter can be called after veto.

gaps.description: /logs/stream and /metrics/stream accept WebSocket connections without API-key validation while HTTP endpoints require the key.
gaps.next_action: Authenticate before WebSocket accept, authorize per tenant/scope, rate-limit and add unauthenticated connection rejection tests.

gaps.description: RiskEngine computes lower-tail VaR/CVaR as negative returns but compares them against positive maximum-risk thresholds; risk sign conventions are inconsistent.
gaps.next_action: Represent VaR/CVaR as positive loss magnitudes or invert comparisons consistently; add positive/negative return fixtures and veto boundary tests.

gaps.description: ArchiveService previous chain hash is held only in instance memory and is lost on restart or across multiple service instances.
gaps.next_action: Recover last trusted chain hash from durable archive transactionally and test restart, concurrent writers and tamper detection.

gaps.description: README and source scan confirm credential fields are embedded in cassandra_v6_FIXED.py and bearer token material is emitted into login events/log prefix.
gaps.next_action: Immediately rotate/revoke embedded account credentials and all issued tokens; purge history after rotation; move secrets to a secret manager and redact tokens from logs/events.

gaps.description: Legacy agi_trader_final_v1.py contains multiple direct mt5.order_send calls; the reviewed repository includes a potentially live order path.
gaps.next_action: Keep the script disabled outside isolated demo; add default-deny execution flag, account/environment allowlist, notional and daily loss limits, operator approval and tests that block order_send by default.

gaps.description: The QPE-like circuit ignores the supplied market binary history; stochastic measurement output is compared to future labels without a causal prediction path.
gaps.next_action: Treat as circuit simulation only; either encode causal history and compare against classical baselines or narrow all claims to a non-predictive Qiskit experiment.

gaps.description: C/Rust/Solidity/Kotlin code generators interpolate action/target strings directly into target-language string literals without escaping, enabling generated-code injection from crafted instructions.
gaps.next_action: Use target-language literal encoders or AST emitters, reject control characters where appropriate, and add adversarial quote/newline/escape payload tests for every target.

gaps.description: Workspace.run_command and execute_python_file execute subprocesses with the user's OS permissions; path guards and command filters do not isolate filesystem, network or process capabilities.
gaps.next_action: Run commands in a dedicated OS/container sandbox with read-only base filesystem, workspace-only mounts, no secrets, no network by default, CPU/memory/time limits and explicit egress policy.

gaps.description: SemanticTrace.record stores the first result line after truncation but does not redact credential patterns, despite documenting that raw credentials are not persisted.
gaps.next_action: Apply structured secret redaction before trace persistence and test API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, private keys and multiline output.

gaps.description: The graph-native runtime and MoE experiments are on unified-v3-generalization-first at a 2026-09-20 commit; default main is documentation/benchmark registry only.
gaps.next_action: Choose an explicit canonical branch/release and pin runtime, checkpoint, data and benchmark artifacts before integrating NEXUS.

gaps.description: RWKV converter and Triton matvec are branch-only; tests use synthetic matrices/checkpoints and no full 2.9B model perplexity or target-GPU performance has been measured.
gaps.next_action: Run exact full-checkpoint restore, aligned held-out logits/PPL, long-context drift, GPU kernel correctness and matched latency/memory benchmarks.

gaps.description: Debt/credit lifecycle repository is documentation-only with five mechanisms and 42 legacy units assigned for rewrite; no executable maturity or expected-loss engine exists.
gaps.next_action: Keep the Financial OS as accounting authority and implement a contract-first maturity/expected-loss module only after ownership and legacy rewrite review.

gaps.description: Compression engine is represented by a source_snapshot gitlink, but .gitmodules is absent; the benchmark repository does not independently expose the exact engine source or a cloneable submodule URL.
gaps.next_action: Add .gitmodules with a stable public source URL and pin commit; provide a reproducible environment lock and benchmark runner.

gaps.description: QTC2 zero-residual exact mode depends on a shared temporal dictionary; dictionary storage/distribution and retention costs must be amortized before claiming net compression savings.
gaps.next_action: Publish full amortized cost model: model bytes, container bytes, update/replication/retention, number of consumers and decoder availability; benchmark against standalone compressors.

gaps.description: Main branch is README-only and contains no executable GGUF compressor.
gaps.next_action: Keep as concept or implement parser/codec with bit-exact round-trip, quantization-quality and compatibility tests.

gaps.description: Main branch is a specification stub without parser, codec or decoder.
gaps.next_action: Define byte-level format, versioning, integrity envelope and cross-language round-trip tests before claiming a compression format.

gaps.description: Science evidence contracts validate digest shape and some epistemic gates but do not verify source bytes against locators; several numeric fields accept NaN/infinity or negative counts because finiteness and range checks are incomplete.
gaps.next_action: Use math.isfinite for every numeric field, constrain counts and physical bounds, validate required identifiers and bind source bytes/digests in a trusted ingestion adapter; add adversarial tests.

gaps.description: The main scenario is an analytical scheduling simulation with no LLM calls, yet repository naming can be mistaken for an empirical multi-agent benchmark if its scope is not repeated in summaries.
gaps.next_action: Keep simulation labels in every result card and distinguish scheduling arithmetic from measured agent quality, token cost, latency and failure rates.

gaps.description: The purged walk-forward helper defaults purge_bars=0 and embargo_bars=0; leakage safety depends on every caller explicitly passing a purge at least as long as the maximum target horizon.
gaps.next_action: Require a declared maximum label horizon in the split contract, derive purge from it, reject negative/insufficient purge and add tests that unsafe defaults cannot be used.

gaps.description: The main README reports pytest stops during collection because main-branch tests import V6.6 modules that are absent from main; the feature implementation is present only on research PR branches.
gaps.next_action: Either merge the complete dependency set with green CI or remove/mark branch-only tests and modules so main is a coherent, reproducible release.

gaps.description: The JSONL append-only chain reads then appends without process locking, atomic commit or fsync; concurrent writers can race on height/previous hash and crashes can leave partial trailing records.
gaps.next_action: Use SQLite transactional append or locked temp-write/fsync/replace, add recovery for partial lines, concurrency tests and externally anchored checkpoints.

gaps.description: ArbitrageExecutor's Cycle A documents the external DEX purchase as simulated and requiring a production router; the checked code does not establish a real external buy/sell leg.
gaps.next_action: Keep the strategy classified as simulation until an allowlisted DEX adapter, atomic settlement path and fork tests against pinned external liquidity are present.

gaps.description: The balanced ledger and idempotent event store are in-memory only; they are not a durable accounting or settlement service.
gaps.next_action: Treat as a deterministic research kernel and only promote after transactional persistence, crash recovery, concurrency control and external settlement boundaries are tested.

gaps.description: Venue quote, approved notional and fill fields are not consistently checked for finiteness, valid ranges and schema integrity; correlation UUIDs do not provide durable idempotency or broker-side deduplication.
gaps.next_action: Validate every numeric with isfinite and non-negative bounds, validate side/symbol/venue IDs and fill invariants, persist plan/result state and implement broker idempotency keys with reconciliation.

gaps.description: Capital governance contract uses Decimal comparisons without is_finite(), so positive Infinity can pass capital_required and max_amount validation.
gaps.next_action: Reject non-finite Decimal values before comparisons, validate currency/UUID/timezone fields and add NaN/Infinity adversarial tests.

gaps.description: Research runners depend on fixed /mnt/data artifacts and one evaluation script executes a source prefix via exec; checkpoint loading uses weights_only=False. This is not a portable or safe untrusted-artifact execution path.
gaps.next_action: Package deterministic entry points, pin and verify checkpoint/source hashes, avoid dynamic exec, use safe checkpoint loading where possible and record exact environment/artifact manifests.

gaps.description: The master dossier's open PR #2 still describes an 89-repository assessment, while the current owner-scoped inventory contains 112 unique repositories.
gaps.next_action: Reconcile the dossier/PR to canonical GitHub IDs and current Hypergraph coverage before promoting it as the master ecosystem assessment.
